issues.problem: V1 used Dilo/Luli almost exclusively and did not deliver six-character Happy Makers leadership.
issues.resolution: All six canonical Happy Makers are integrated with distinct roles, 31 HM CHAT exchanges, and the Seventh Seat payoff.

issues.problem: 31 useful days felt too independent; progress was implied rather than accumulated.
issues.resolution: Five-stage arc, four checkpoints, 31 observable field results, cumulative field kit and escalating independence.

issues.problem: FREE ROAM pages were mostly generic blank brain-dump pages.
issues.resolution: All 31 now capture day-specific evidence, decisions, or checkpoint proof while preserving open space.

issues.problem: Ending was practical but did not fully deliver team attachment or desire to continue.
issues.resolution: Competitive finale selected Seventh Seat + Personal Field Kit; page 189 gives six-voice welcome and future-mission hook.

issues.problem: Three legacy cheat codes contradicted or undercut upgraded day mechanics.
issues.resolution: D11, D16 and D26 framing fixed without changing puzzle truth.

issues.problem: D6 and D26 could stall if a trusted adult was not available that day.
D31 System Reboot revealed RESET immediately before the Final Key puzzle.
issues.resolution: Spoiler removed; page now leads into the puzzle without naming the answer.

issues.problem: Owner required all V1 safety/consent gains to survive the V2 rewrite.
issues.resolution: Bullying escalation, trusted-adult support, private alternatives, optional disclosure/sharing and no-treatment boundary preserved.
